dimensions.assessment: Affects taxpayers who experience federally declared disasters or other qualifying events and file tax refund claims or receive collection notices.
dimensions.evidence: postponement of the federal tax return deadline due to a federally declared disaster or certain other events

dimensions.assessment: Extends eligibility windows for tax refunds that might otherwise be time-barred and adjusts notice timelines for tax payments.
dimensions.evidence: treated as an extension of time for filing such return... for purposes of section 6511(b)(2)(A)

dimensions.assessment: May increase federal tax refund payouts by allowing previously excluded withholdings or payments within the revised lookback period.
dimensions.evidence: certain tax payments... made before the federal tax return is filed may be outside the lookback period and non-refundable

dimensions.assessment: Amends sections 6303 and 7508A of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 regarding disaster relief administrative rules.
dimensions.evidence: Section 7508A of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended by adding at the end the following new subsection

dimensions.assessment: Applies permanently to claims filed and notices issued after the date of enactment for all future disaster postponements.
dimensions.evidence: apply to claims filed after the date of the enactment of this Act

missing_information: The aggregate annual dollar amount of additional tax refunds expected to be claimed as a result of the extended lookback period.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the IRS to treat disaster-related tax return and payment deadline postponements as extensions when calculating tax refund lookback periods and issuing collection notices.
